summary: Enhance your skills in GIS and Remote Sensing for effective Natural Resource Management. Join our training programs and make a positive impact today!
lede: GIS and remote sensing training helps natural resource professionals use satellite imagery and field data for land and conservation decisions. Participants practice preparing spatial datasets, classifying land cover and detecting change, then planning field validation and producing maps and monitoring reports for managers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use spatial data to support land, water, forest, conservation, or environmental decisions. It fits practitioners who need stronger day-to-day capability in GIS and remote sensing, plus managers and technical specialists who must turn imagery and field data into credible outputs.
modules: Remote sensing classification and change analysis
prerequisites: Bring a laptop capable of running ArcGIS Pro or QGIS, depending on your organization’s preferred platform. You should also be prepared to work with sample satellite imagery, GPS points, and simple spreadsheet-based attribute data during the labs.
